summary: Compiled 108 audited rows and 32 transfers into a three-layer Instagram guideline set organised by the judged taxonomy: L1 platform (69 lines: MUST gates, DEFAULT mechanisms, TRY experiments, and the null results recorded as noise) with a 37-key parameter block; a thin middle of standards-only cards (archetype x7, involvement x3 with the B2B/B2C audience modifier, locale as a qualifier) plus eight category packs (marketing-advertising, tech-business-news, startups-venture, fashion-intimates, travel-local-discovery, personal-finance-investing, music-nightlife, luxury-hospitality-real-estate) each within 25 lines; and nine client DNAs within 15 lines each carrying the classification record, the resolved parameter values, the client's own standards and the transfers as TRY lines with their twist. Rows refuted by both skeptics were dropped (X1 photo-dominant to intimates, whose substance survives in L1 IMG-01/H-3 and the Hanky Panky DNA); rows refuted once were narrowed (D-2/DS-09/GFX-02 'no device by default' to TRY at L1 and DEFAULT in startups and fintech; SCR-01 to TRY at L1 and DEFAULT in tech news; TOP-05 credit DEFAULT with the Collab invite TRY; X3, X-03, X-17 to the narrower experiments named). Owner standards and defects keep the scope he stated: fonts, two sizes plus meta, complete sentences, boxes in the client's language, the logo rule, uploaded-beats-scraped, background removal, shaded photo covers and set integrity (no two slides alike) are MUST at L1 with 23 defects mapped to WS-01..13 and their guards. Version 1.1 applies the alignment review: every DNA is validated against the L1 size ratios, floors, cover and word caps and the logo rule (DNAs choose only logo variant, position, treatment and presence); a kit-declared font substitute is a FONT_HOLD unless the owner signs it off and is shown on the gate card; code-built icons and graphics are a default capability with per-kit bands; complete sentences are a MUST with a label list; small-n pack lines are conventions or TRYs; Reels craft, a trend-watch, a pooled scale pass and faster experiments are added at L1. Performance claims live only at L1 (global, one vote per account) and L3; category packs and facet cards hold standards and parameter values, with the industry statistics carried as evidence refs, because the grouping test found involvement, archetype and audience ahead of industry and every card failing on carousels alone. 24 decisions are listed for the owner with data-backed recommendations, the largest being the logo corner, logo precedence, label faces, font licences, capped full-bleed covers over #244, the end of the three-generated-frames guarantee, the D45 scraping carve-out and the facet skill gate.

Tie-break: the voice the account actually posts in (first-person human = person; editorial or curatorial = publisher). Adding a value needs a registry PR approved by Albert.
lines: [DEFAULT][language] brand (consumer product brand): voice = the brand in first person plural or a creator first person; face on camera = customers, models and creators across the size range; produced look with candid moments; collab_style = creators and models as Collabs; news pegs only via cultural moments; series affinity medium (drops, quizzes). (evidence: robustness-v2 archetype skill +0.0085 p=0.01; taxonomy judge:taxonomy)

[DEFAULT][language] place (local business, venue, property): voice = the house, sober third person; face on camera = staff and consenting people living the place, never guests; produced look; collab_style = non-competing partners with consent; news pegs = season and official dates; series affinity high (fixed weekday lanes). (evidence: N3 client rules 12-19; luxury set: staff sequences, faces +0.27 6+/3-)

[DEFAULT][language] person (creator, artist, personality, educator): voice = first-person human; face on camera = the person, candid and in action; UGC-grade look accepted; collab_style = venues and brands as Collabs; news pegs = the person's own moments; series affinity medium; 'educator/advisor' folds in until 5+ benchmark accounts exist. (evidence: taxonomy closed list; Sitti founder reels 14x followers)

[DEFAULT][language] publisher (media, news, curation): voice = editorial 'we' or faceless; face on camera = the subject of the story, never the desk; produced look with the subject's own media credited; collab_style = named subjects and sources; news pegs = the product itself with a freshness gate; series affinity low to medium (numbered weeklies as TRY); audio_source = licensed library or original upload on business accounts. (evidence: Geektime and DT syntheses; publisher promos 0.04-0.09x)

[DEFAULT][language] platform (consumer app, software, marketplace): voice = the product's people in second person to the user; face on camera = the named creator or customer, the founder for reach; produced look with real product UI as the only device; collab_style = the creator or customer whose story it is; news pegs = rule changes and city events; series affinity high (fixed skeleton per series). (evidence: Sitti and XO L3 rules; creator-app product-as-graphic)

[DEFAULT][language] business (B2B company, agency, service): voice = conversational first person plural of the team, one decisive strategist; face on camera = named people from case subjects, archival; produced look, graphic-led interiors; collab_style = the featured brand or person only when a partner agreed; news pegs = live events by name; series affinity high (named numbered series). (evidence: Karos July grid; B2B conversational 7+/1-)

[DEFAULT][language] institution (programme, event, competition, community): voice = the programme addressing founders or members, warm and specific; face on camera = participants, judges and winners on real stages; produced look from the programme's own archive; collab_style = judges, verified winners and partners as Collabs; news pegs = application dates, finals, launches; series affinity high (pillars). (evidence: The Pitch L3 rules; @getdeel co-posts 9.9-17.8k vs 354 plays)

[MUST][process] audio_source is a fact read from the Instagram account type (business vs creator) and is never overridden by a lower layer; business accounts use the licensed library or the original upload only. (evidence: FMT-02; Meta music licensing for business accounts)

[DEFAULT][cadence] cadence_default by archetype: publisher follows the news flow (Geektime daily, DT 18/week bespoke); brand, platform and business 3-5 a week; institution 5-6 around its season; place 2-3 a week bound by asset supply. (evidence: CAD-01 per-client extents)

industry_kits.kit: facet-involvement (closed list of 3) + audience modifier (B2B / B2C / mixed; two keys only)
clients: hankypanky: low (borderline, AOV rationale logged), B2C
industry_kits.params: owns: default_post_job_mix (entertain/inspire/educate/convince), brand_vs_activation_ratio (60:40 default), cta_intensity, register_intensity, format_lead. Audience modifier may shift exactly two keys: brand_vs_activation_ratio (toward 50:50 for B2B) and proof_person_style (named company or person for B2B). Three-question rule on the primary revenue line: (a) is the posting itself what the audience comes for, money following attention? none; (b) does acting need research, money or commitment (regulated, order > ~$100, B2B contract, an application costing days)? high; (c) otherwise low. A product line may override involvement per run.
lines: [DEFAULT][strategy] none (content is the product): post-job mix seed 4 entertain / 2 educate / 0 convince; brand_vs_activation 80:20; cta_intensity none (a credit line, no ask); register plain authoritative or editorial; format_lead follows the page's own grid (reels or 2-slide cards). (evidence: DT 'no CTA' 14% vs 12%; music authoritative 7+/0-; taxonomy judge seeds are authored, not measured)

[DEFAULT][strategy] low (act within minutes, under ~$100, unregulated): mix seed 3 entertain / 1 educate / 2 convince; brand_vs_activation 60:40; cta_intensity one answerable ask per post, rotated; register emotional or creator first-person; format_lead neutral, decided by the client's own grid. (evidence: intimates comment prompt 11+/1- p=0.006; creator emotional 5+/0-; format neutral within intimates)

[DEFAULT][strategy] high (research, money, commitment or regulated): mix seed 2 entertain / 3 educate / 1 convince; brand_vs_activation 60:40 (50:50 with the B2B modifier); cta_intensity low (save/share, a waitlist, or none; never comment bait); register conversational; format_lead carousel for text-and-picture accounts, judged on saves and sends. (evidence: startup and B2B link-in-bio 2+/7- and 0.6; a16z carousels 1.14x vs images 0.80x)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Audience modifier B2B: brand_vs_activation to 50:50 and proof_person_style = named company or named person; B2C and mixed leave both keys at the involvement default. (evidence: robustness-v2 audience skill +0.0066; Binet & Field emotion works in B2B too, per taxonomy judge)

[MUST][process] Involvement never carries an engagement delta until the facet passes the skill gate (leave-one-account-out skill >= +0.01 with perm_p < 0.05 on two consecutive runs, >= 20 accounts per group, surviving the drop of any one source client, and winning in the L3 data of >= 2 Karos clients); until then these rows are standards only. (evidence: robustness-v2 involvement +0.0096 p=0.01 but carousels-only negative; design:impact jackknife)
[DEFAULT][process] Mix seeds are re-checked quarterly against the override log: a default overturned in most clients is demoted. (evidence: taxonomy judge how_guidance_composes)

industry_kits.kit: facet-locale (qualifier, not a layer: en, he, pt-BR, fr, es, multi)
clients: en: karoslabs, thepitchbydeel, hankypanky, kindlyyours, sitti, dontechno
industry_kits.params: owns: script direction, register pack (readable-copy pattern sets), number/date/currency format, proofing pass, jurisdiction key fed to the L1 claims gate. Resolved exact locale, then base language, then default. Locale pools no evidence (perm_p 0.51-0.68).
lines: [MUST][language] en: base readable-copy pack ('X is not A. It is B.', 'Not X.' openers, fragment stacks, triads, meta lines, trailing ellipsis); jurisdiction from the client. (evidence: LANG-02; LANG-14)

[MUST][language] he (Geektime): RTL layout and bidi digits, mark anchored top-right or right of centre, letter-height floors instead of x-height, a face with native Hebrew glyphs in every role and the same family for Latin names, gender and number agreement, no Latin glued to Hebrew, at most one 'לא X.' per caption, no English corporate jargon, shekel placement and RTL bar order, 'תמונה: עיבוד AI' as the AI label; the pack needs a native reviewer before it may refuse a draft. (evidence: LANG-14/GFX-04/IMG-02/DS-10 locale notes; Geektime run shipped five 'לא X.')

[MUST][language] pt-BR (XO, jurisdiction BR): 'você' address, no English on slides, 'não X, mas Y' and 'O teto não era X. Era Y.' banned, decimal comma and 'R$ 6,5 mi', accented capitals at display line-height >= 1.1 and diacritics tested at ExtraBold, longer words with no hyphenation; jurisdiction BR selects the CVM claims list for the L1 claims gate. (evidence: LANG-14/LANG-02/A-2/C-3 locale notes; XO run 'O teto não era de capacidade. Era de regra.')

[MUST][language] fr (N3): complete French sentences with one fact each, technical words explained, no two-word flourishes, no anglicisms, no em dashes, non-breaking space before : ; ? !, accented capitals at line-height >= 1.1 and the degree sign checked in the kit faces, '1850' is a name never a measurement, no roman numerals; jurisdiction FR for the site's legal gate. (evidence: C-4/LANG-14/C-3 locale notes; albert-copy-must-mean-something)
[DEFAULT][language] es and multi: stubs that fall back to the base pack with a native proofread; opened as packs only when a client arrives. (evidence: taxonomy closed list)

industry_kits.params: archetype business; involvement high; audience B2B (mix 50:50, named-company proof); locale en. photoShareMin 0.3-0.4 (photo covers, graphic interiors); graphicsMix data-led 2-4 per 8 slides from a shared device library; interiorWordLane editorial 15-25 (max 35); slideCountBand 5-7; coverWords 3-9, <=7 on photo covers; H cover 96-110 with T 44 and S 30 on the cover (H:T <=2.5, H:S <=4), interior 64-72 same position every slide, T >=44, S 30 (26-28 only for tracked caps), one stat size only as a lone figure; iconBand 1-3 labelled icons per 8 slides in the client's icon style, 0 on covers; tables in the captured table style; captionChars 90-180 words in 3-5 paragraphs; askSet {save-for-X, keyword-DM, none} optional and rotated; hashtags <=5 from a topic pool; emoji 0; register conversational; questionForm answered; headlineTier large (huge-short TRY); devicesPerSlide 1 interior / 0 cover; logoPresence every slide (cover-off TRY); accentAreaMax 5%; formatPrior carousel 0.7 / reel 0.3 (TRY); aiImagery concept-labelled; stock never for people, avoid otherwise; screenshotsPerDeck <=2 never slide 1; timeliness: live news pegs by name, campaign anniversaries TRY; peer set 14 B2B accounts (nogood.io, orenmeetsworld, sintra.ai, peoplebrandsandthings, thebrandblueprint_, reputeforge...), median ER 0.279%.
lines: [DEFAULT][strategy] The subject is a named brand, campaign or person with a live peg; house work enters at most 1 post in 3 and as the output, never the pitch (internal posts are the weakest pillar in B2B accounts). (evidence: TOP-01/LANG-04 karoslabs; J-5)

[DEFAULT][imagery] Imagery comes from archival and public-domain sources (Wikimedia Commons, Library of Congress, Smithsonian), press and plain product shots, credited on the slide and in the caption; stock is avoided and never used for people. (evidence: IMG-04/IMG-05; storm-lead B2B kit stock lift 0.29)

[DEFAULT][graphics] Each interior slide is a picture of the point: one graphic that carries the fact (real asset, real UI, found ad, diagram, side-by-side comparison) beside 15-25 words. (evidence: storm-lead L2-02 comparison lift 3.33; owner M)
[DEFAULT][graphics] Covers carry no icons, charts, screenshots or big-stat devices. (evidence: B2B icons 1+/6-, boxes 2+/7- scale.md; storm-lead cover graphics 0.4-0.5)

[DEFAULT][graphics] Interiors add labelled icons by default at 1-3 per 8 slides in the client's icon style (an icon row for a 3-step chain, a chip beside a stat, a feature list), each counting as the slide's one device. (evidence: GFX-01/GFX-03; owner M 'add icons'; B2B icons 1+/6- is TRY-level at n=7 and measured unlabelled decoration)

[DEFAULT][graphics] Devices are hairline cards with one accent mark each and no gradients; the accent covers at most about 5% of the slide's pixels. (evidence: D-1 karoslabs; storm-lead accent-area param; owner 'orange stays on data fills')
[DEFAULT][language] Register is conversational B2B with no hype and no informational flatness. (evidence: B2B conversational +0.25 7+/1- p=0.07, informational 2+/6- scale.md)
[DEFAULT][language] Captions stay short to medium (90-180 words, sourced inline, series label allowed) and are not lengthened for this audience. (evidence: LANG-12; B2B long 4+/6-, short +0.17 3+/1-)
[DEFAULT][hook] A cover states a claim; a question appears only when the same slide answers it. (evidence: LANG-13; B2B question 2+/4-)
[DEFAULT][strategy] Comparisons are shown side by side, AI products are shown through their output, and live news is pegged by name. (evidence: storm-lead B2B kit; L2-02)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Entry points: campaign anatomy, brand origin story, a pricing or positioning move, an AI tool's actual output, agency craft, a named marketer's career, then-versus-now pairs, an owned data study, a live event or launch, a hiring decision. (evidence: Karos series set; a16z archival 5/5 at 2x)

[DEFAULT][process] Compliance: archival media is credited on the slide and in the caption, no trademark is used as an icon, and no client's work is shown without permission. (evidence: ORIG-01/GFX-03)

[DEFAULT][format] Format prior is carousel-led with reels only as TRY slots until the peer test shows the audience is reel-trained. (evidence: FMT-01 karoslabs; peers 1.41-1.80x on carousel-led vs 0.37-0.56x on reel-trained audiences)
[TRY][logo] Cover without the lockup versus the lockup on every slide, read on the benchmark since the client's own account cannot score it. (evidence: DS-11; B2B none 8+/1- p=0.04, top-left 1+/7-)
[TRY][font sizes] Huge headline on covers of 7 words or fewer versus large. (evidence: DS-04; B2B huge 7+/1- p=0.07)
[TRY][design] A bold brand accent in one device versus a quiet version. (evidence: DS-07; B2B brand-colour heavy 5+/1-; storm-lead L1-19 killed at L1)
[TRY][language] Emotional or personal register and story hooks, untested in this set. (evidence: P-1; fintech source 7+/2-; B2B emotional 0.0 over 5 accounts)

[TRY][graphics] An owned-data series: one checkable finding per carousel from the benchmark, the number inside a sentence on a real image pair, code-built charts, n stated, no causal words. (evidence: X-03 narrowed once; Wired and Visual Capitalist data journalism)
[TRY][format] A typographic manifesto of fact-then-consequence pairs, one sentence per slide at one size on alternating grounds. (evidence: X-04; a16z manifestos 3/4 at 2x)

[DEFAULT][process] Campaign launches come from an upstream registry (brands' own newsrooms and channels, agency case pages, award shortlists, trade launch feeds), and every news-pegged post is logged as first or follower with the origin's age. (evidence: Q-2/TOP-04 transfer from Don Techno; DT upstream sources 3.5-4.9 days ahead of aggregators, first 3.25x vs 0.49x)

[TRY][strategy] One defended position a week on a named source (a campaign result, a pricing move, a platform policy), the argument in the caption, as the comment lane. (evidence: Q-4 transfer from Don Techno; DT's only two 6,000+ comment posts were a study and a policy)
tries: X3 one size per slide (narrowed, low priority)

industry_kits.kit: ig-kit-tech-business-news (tech and business news media; Hebrew today)
industry_kits.params: archetype publisher; involvement none; audience mixed; locale he (Geektime). formatPrior image 0.5 / carousel-2 0.35 / reel 0.15; slideCountBand 1-2 (more only when every slide adds a fact); photoShareMin 0.5 with the cover always a photo; interiorWordLane news 25-35 at one size (L1 lane; was 30-50); coverWords 5-9 as a TRY cap (hard total cap 20 on the card cover); H one bold size of 68-76px on 2-3 lines (was a ~4.4% line height) + optional overline at 0.6x (>=41px); T single size >=44px; S credit >=30px (Hebrew has no caps); iconBand 0-2 labelled icons per post, mirrored in RTL; captionChars 300-650; hashtags <=1; emoji 1 on line 1; register plain authoritative, dry; questionForm none on covers; askSet {house article pointer (not counted), comment_finite TRY}; devicesPerSlide 1 comparison readable in a second; graphicsMix editorial 1-3; screenshotsPerDeck <=2 as a receipt on slide 2 (DEFAULT); twoSlideShare 0.3; freshness 7 days; measurement window 24-48 h; upstream registry and first-mover logging DEFAULT (target 2 firsts a week); aiImagery concept-labelled; stock avoid; thirdPartyShareMax media-high with credits; peer set 12 Hebrew tech accounts + wired, themarker_online, morningbrew, visualcap, evolving.ai; median ER 0.187%.
lines: [MUST][language] The lead fact is 7 days old or less or its date is on the slide; news verbs never dress an old milestone. (evidence: LANG-08; Geektime 15-month stat presented as 'reached')

[DEFAULT][strategy] Every story carries a reader stake: a local price or saving, an availability date, something free, or a named person's story. (evidence: Geektime L3; news with a reader stake 8+/2- p=0.11; winners median 12.3x and 4.1x)

[DEFAULT][strategy] House programmes and partner content never run as news, and partners stay off the cover. (evidence: publisher promos Calcalist TECH1 0.09x, WIRED event 0.07x, Visual Capitalist webinar 0.04x; partner logos 31.9% weakest vs 12.5% best)

[DEFAULT][hook] The cover headline is named actor + active verb + consequence on 2-3 lines; the 5-9-word cap is a TRY, not a rule, because the set's best covers run longer. (evidence: H-2/LANG-17 geektime; cover words median +3, 9+/2-)
[DEFAULT][hook] An open question is not a hook; ask only after the fact is delivered. (evidence: LANG-13; open questions 5.6% of best vs 13.9% of weakest)

[DEFAULT][format] Single image by default; a carousel is a 2-slide hook-then-receipt or one new fact or voice per slide, never a slide that restates the cover. (evidence: SLD-02/SCR-01 narrowed; hook-then-receipt 26.5x and 7.61x; feed 75% single images)

[DEFAULT][imagery] The cover is photo-dominant in this order: own product photography, vendor press, a screenshot receipt, a labelled concept last; never a generated scene of a real event or person. (evidence: photo-dominant +0.27 10+/1- p=0.012; product photo 5+/1-; IMG-04 geektime)

[DEFAULT][design] Headlines sit inside the house card or plate, never raw on the photo, and there are no full dark or muted plates. (evidence: medium contrast 0+/8- p=0.008; dark 1+/9- p=0.02; muted 0+/8-; high contrast 6+/0-)

[DEFAULT][graphics] One comparison readable in a second per story: a giant numeral, a before-and-after price, a ranked bar, or the source document as slide 2, with up to 2 labelled icons mirrored for RTL; illustration is the last rung. (evidence: GFX-01/GFX-03/GFX-05; big number 3+/0- and illustration 1+/6- are TRY-level at n<8)

[DEFAULT][process] Upstream registry as the sixth topic engine: company newsrooms, investor-relations pages, exchange and SEC filings, the national innovation authority, importer price pages, founders' and VCs' accounts; a story is saturated when 3 competing desks ran it in 7 days unless the angle is new. (evidence: TOP-04; DT upstream sources 3.5-4.9 days ahead of aggregators)

[DEFAULT][language] Captions run 300-650 characters in ~12-word sentences with digits, a one-line hook first, and close on the article pointer plus the photo credit; the pointer is a house line, not the ask. (evidence: LANG-12/LANG-09 geektime; tech news medium +0.18 6+/1-; link-in-bio 3+/3- null)
[DEFAULT][process] Measure after 24-48 hours at least, use comments where likes are hidden, and never rank a post under 96 hours on a busy page. (evidence: J-1; Calcalist 'worst' were 4-12 h old)
[DEFAULT][format] Reels run only with native footage, never sponsored clips. (evidence: reel -0.27 2+/8-; Doom native footage 13.36x)
[DEFAULT][strategy] Credit named people and companies and source their own media first; the Collab invite is a TRY. (evidence: TOP-05 narrowed; named-person stories median 4.11x)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Entry points: a launch or price in the local market, funding or layoffs with a named person, a regulation change, a device in hand, an exit anniversary, a reader-facing feature, local availability, a security incident, a hiring wave, a gadget comparison. (evidence: Geektime winners; X-01/X-02)

[DEFAULT][process] Compliance: press images credited in the post language, the AI label in the credit line, a 'scoop' label only for true scoops with a stake, no publisher reach metrics on slides. (evidence: LANG-08 geektime; ORIG-01)

[DEFAULT][process] First-mover from the upstream registry: post first, log every news post as first or follower with origin age, target 2 firsts a week, and review after 3 weeks against a 1.5x median over followers. (evidence: X-02 promoted from logging-only; DT 3.25x first vs 0.49x four hours later)

[TRY][strategy] Story-behind anniversaries from the national tech canon (exits, IPOs, launches, founding dates verified against filings) with a present-day stake, one a week for 5 weeks (the L1 5-posts-per-arm read). (evidence: X-01; DT story-behind 40% of outliers, median 3.5x; nostalgia saturates 29% to 24%)
[TRY][language] A named person's emotional stake quoted in their own words on the cover within the freshness gate. (evidence: X5; fintech emotional 7+/2-; tech news 5 accounts only)
[TRY][language] One concrete, easy comment ask after the fact. (evidence: LANG-10 geektime; generic 'what do you think' does not separate winners)
[TRY][format] Stickers or emoji marks on covers, recorded only. (evidence: stickers/emoji +0.29 3+/1-, n=4)

[TRY][strategy] One defended position a week on a named source (a regulation, a platform policy, a study), stated as the desk's reading, as the comment lane. (evidence: Q-4 transfer from Don Techno; DT's only two 6,000+ comment posts were a study and a policy)
tries: Q-3 media tier (story lockup, publisher captions)

industry_kits.params: archetype institution; involvement high; audience mixed (founders and investors); locale en. carouselShapes payoff+proof (2) / wordless photo sequence (5-10) / one line per slide to a turn (6-10); coverWords 5-8 (<=10 hard); interiorWordLane story 0-12 (best median 4), one dense reference slide allowed behind a 7-word cover; photoShareMin 0.6; devicesPerSlide 0 default, <=1 kit device, none on covers; graphicsMix kit-only minimal; H ~4.5% of height on interiors and 96-104px on the cover, T ~2% raised to >=44, S >=26 in tracked caps (rail and pills; 30 otherwise); iconBand 0-2 labelled line icons inside the kit's pills on interiors; manifesto one size; captionChars 300-450; hashtags <=4; emoji 0; register conversational and personal; questionForm none; askSet {none, save/share in caption, client-mandated pointer}; logo at the L1 equal-area size or none, never the parent brand; formatPrior carousel-led, reels ranked by views; aiImagery never; stock never; typeface register: no condensed all-caps; timeliness: archival 'then' family TRY, programme news only as a launch; measurement hidden likes -> views and Insights; peer set 13 accounts (a16z, join_ef, founderspodcast, sahilbloom, deelpitch...), median ER 0.288%.
lines: [DEFAULT][graphics] No device by default; at most one kit device per slide (a labelled icon inside a pill counts as it, 0-2 per 8 slides) and none on covers; a client's captured device vocabulary outranks this default (D-1). (evidence: DS-09; startup graphic_devices none +0.36 8+/0- p=0.008, the strongest signal in the set; boxes 2+/5-, icons 0+/4-)
[DEFAULT][imagery] Real people, rooms and stages only: no AI, no stock. (evidence: stock 0+/5- p=0.06; a16z 0 of 17 outliers illustrated, its one illustrated carousel 0.73x)

[DEFAULT][hook] The cover carries 5-8 words with a name, a number or a claim, the payoff visible on slide 1; no question and no 'N tips'. (evidence: best cover median 5 vs 8 weakest; a16z 9 of top 10 covers <=10 words)

[DEFAULT][layout] Story slides carry 12 words or fewer and a dense reference slide 35 at most (the L1 hard cap); explainers with 25-54 words do not spread. (evidence: a16z story slides 0-12; explainers 0/5 at 2x; series 1.0x to 0.46x)

[DEFAULT][format] Three shapes: payoff plus proof (2 slides), a wordless photo sequence (5-10), one line per slide to a turn (6-10). (evidence: SLD-01 thepitchbydeel; a16z archival median 9.5x, manifestos 4.7x)

[DEFAULT][design] Restrained type register: no condensed all-caps display; full-bleed photo with an overlaid headline is the house cover. (evidence: condensed 0+/9- p=0.004; full-bleed +0.17 8+/2-; distinct sizes 4+ 0+/5-)
[DEFAULT][language] Register is conversational and personal, never hype, never flat informational, no exclamation marks. (evidence: informational 1+/6-; muted 4+/7-)

[DEFAULT][language] The carousel ends on the idea; no follow card, and the call to action lives in the caption or is absent. (evidence: LANG-09; a16z end cards 0/11 at 2x vs 12/28; link-in-bio 2+/7-; captions with a CTA 0.59x vs 1.02x)
[DEFAULT][language] Captions run 300-450 characters, the first line restates the cover declaratively, at most 4 hashtags, no emoji. (evidence: LANG-12; a16z 0/72 emoji, 2/72 hashtags)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Topics are founders' and companies' origins, pitching as a craft and primary artifacts (a founder's own tweet or first website); glossaries, trend charts and VC mechanics are reference content that does not spread. (evidence: a16z archival 5/5 at >=2x, tweet carousels 2/2, reference 0/12; VC terms 0.46x)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Programme news spreads only as a big launch with partner co-posts; one offer and one interview a week, never a repeated flyer. (evidence: a16z Academy launch 2.65x vs routine 0.24-1.16x; TOP-01 thepitchbydeel)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Credit and source the founder's, judge's or partner's own media first; the Collab is the kit's strongest TRY. (evidence: TOP-05 narrowed; Collab 1.38x vs 0.85x; @getdeel co-posts 9.9-17.8k plays vs 354 solo)
[DEFAULT][cadence] Franchises rotate and a guest never stacks. (evidence: a16z explainer 1.0x to 0.46x over 5 editions; 3 Brockman posts in 4 days 0.14-0.42x)

[DEFAULT][process] Likes are hidden on the client and many peers: rank reels by views and carousels by Insights, never placeholder likes. (evidence: J-1; @deelpitch likes hidden since 2026-08-18, reel median 354 plays)
[DEFAULT][imagery] Talking-head and banner reels are demoted; the same founders in archival footage do 1.06-5.43x. (evidence: a16z talking-head 0/6 at 2x, median 0.19x)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Entry points: applications open and close, a regional final, a judge's question, a winner's path, pitch craft, a founder's first company from public record, prize mechanics in exact wording, backstage, a city spotlight, the first 'no'. (evidence: The Pitch pillars; a16z families)

[DEFAULT][process] Compliance: prizes and programme mechanics only in the client's exact wording, no implied endorsement by uninvolved famous people, licensed or own images only, never a global champion implied. (evidence: LANG-08; a16z do-not-copy 9)
[TRY][format] An all-video carousel of one event night from several angles, 6-7 MP4 slides, the only headline on slide 1, labels after. (evidence: X-13; music all-video 1.52, 6-7 video slides 2.02)
[TRY][strategy] A founder's first-person moment around the act of pitching on a real backstage photo, as a Collab. (evidence: X6; fintech emotional 7+/2-; client 5+/3-)
[TRY][format] A wordless photo sequence of the programme's own events with names in the caption. (evidence: X7; luxury wordless 5+/1-; 4 target accounts only)

industry_kits.kit: ig-kit-music-nightlife (music media, scene pages, nightlife; from the Don Techno system and 9 tagged pages)
industry_kits.params: archetype publisher (person if run as one DJ's voice); involvement none; audience B2C; locale en. photoShareMin 0.9-1.0 (footage); textSizes 2 sans + 1 small tracked mono source/date line; cover lockup: eyebrow 'source · date' <=35 chars at the S size / kicker <=22 chars at the T size (~48px) / NAME largest (120 -> 96px then wrap, so NAME:kicker <=2.5 and NAME:eyebrow <=4); body slide: eyebrow + one 60px headline on 70px lines, <=4 lines, >=36px; proof slides: footage with a top label only; colour from the footage, no accent, no devices, no charts; graphicsMix and iconBand 0 (footage-led: nothing covers the footage); scrim always on (clear above ~42%, ~88% black at the edge) plus a top veil for the mark; logo one fixed corner, no handle, index or credit on the plate; canvas 1080x1440 cards, 1080x1920 reels; shapes: 2-slide claim+proof (twoSlideShare 0.25), all-video carousels 6-10 clips (videoSlideShare 0.3 TRY), reels 10-20 s or 60-90 s (avoid 20-30 s, unstable, re-measure per client); footage gates in code (720p floor, 1080 export, YAVG >=20 in the first 2 s, brightness >=55, no stickers, watermarks, ads or AI); captionChars long, story in order, credit line mandatory, ~2 hashtags; askSet none (credit line instead); register plain authoritative; questionForm statement; timeliness weekly targets carousel current 3 / evergreen 1 / nostalgic 1 / bridge 1 and reel 3/4/3/2 scaled to cadence, nostalgic brake at 35%, why-now within 7 days; dedupe same clip never, storyline 60 d, entity 2 d; doors: virality >=3x the author's own median age-projected, sweet spot >=1.10 of own median; position lane <=1 a week on a named source; measurement comments where likes are hidden (22-77% of posts); peer set 9 pages (don.techno, defected, mixmagmagazine, 6am_group, technoandhousemusic, boilerroomtv, ra_news, cercle, edmmusic), median ER 0.114%.
lines: [MUST][imagery] Third-party clips appear only with a credit line and a collaborator invite (the invite doubles as the permission request); publishers use own, partner or licensed footage; music on business accounts comes from the licensed library or the original upload; no AI media presented as real footage or news. (evidence: dt.json hard_rules; ORIG-01/FMT-02)

[MUST][process] A hidden like count is never read as a number; comments carry the measure on pages where likes are hidden. (evidence: J-1; 22-77% of posts hide likes on the 9 pages; DT 82 of 102 posts)

[DEFAULT][design] The pack's convention is photo-led with colour from ungraded footage: no accent colour, devices, charts or icons over the footage (graphicsMix and iconBand 0). (evidence: devices 6 uses across 54 best posts on 9 pages; bright designed colour 0+/6- p=0.03 and dark 5+/1- are TRY-level at n=6)

[DEFAULT][font sizes] Two sans sizes per slide plus one small tracked mono source-and-date line (a declared label mono may set the date there, C-5), NAME at 120px at most, white caps, left-aligned lower third, never over a face. (evidence: Q-3/DS-02 dontechno; distinct sizes 0-1 4+/0-; the origin of the owner's two-sizes rule)

[DEFAULT][design] The bottom gradient is always on under type (clear above ~42% of height, ~88% black at the edge) with a light top veil for the mark and labels. (evidence: H-1 dontechno; a16z 7-34/255 behind text)

[DEFAULT][language] One plain spoken sentence of about 10 words naming the subject and the moment; authoritative scene knowledge wins and hype loses; questions in 2% of top posts. (evidence: authoritative +0.26 7+/0- p=0.016; hype -0.36 0+/7- p=0.016; the same clip 0.35 vague vs 2.95 named)

[DEFAULT][format] The 2-slide claim-plus-proof card beats 3-5 slide carousels within every page that posts both; all-video carousels of one night lead the format table. (evidence: 2 slides 1.17 vs 3 slides 0.91 (4/4 pages); all-video 1.52, 6-7 video slides 2.02, n=45)

[DEFAULT][format] Reels run 10-20 s or 60-90 s, never 20-30 s, and the band is re-measured per client because it flipped between periods; the whole moment is kept and only dead air trimmed. (evidence: 10-20 s 1.21 n=41; 60-90 s 1.60 n=35; 20-30 s 0.74 n=71; UNSTABLE)

[DEFAULT][strategy] The story behind a well-known record, looked up in its documented history and posted on its anniversary with one little-known fact, is the strongest lane. (evidence: 40% of outliers, median 3.5x; track or sample origin 2.13)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Watch one step upstream (talk shows' own channels, newsrooms, promoters, venue shooters), post first, and penalise a story once 3 tracked pages ran it in 7 days unless the angle is new; re-check a trend before committing. (evidence: TOP-04; first 3.25x vs 0.49x four hours later; IG-born stories reach big pages 3.5-4.9 days late)
[DEFAULT][strategy] Every reachable subject gets a collab invite and a credit line; the subject's own media comes first. (evidence: collab 1.37 vs 0.98; artist-owned collab reels 4.26)

[DEFAULT][hook] Each post carries a timeliness class with a why-now for throwbacks (anniversary within 7 days, trending again, played this season, the artist active now); nostalgia saturates. (evidence: bridge 1.37, nostalgic 1.17, current 0.99; aggregators' nostalgic share 29% to 24%)

[DEFAULT][cadence] Dedupe windows are measured on the page's own repeats: the same clip never, the same storyline 60 days, the same artist 2 days. (evidence: CAD-02; storyline cost 16% inside 60 d, artist 33% at 1-2 d, nothing from day 3, on 1,074 posts)

[DEFAULT][language] Captions are long, tell the story in order, carry the mandatory credit line and about 2 hashtags, and force no ask. (evidence: long +0.29 6+/0- p=0.03; medium 1+/6-; no CTA 14% vs 12%)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Ticket and lineup promos, logistics reposts, link digests, gig recaps of unknown names, posed portraits and talking-head reels sit at the bottom of every tagged page; plain single images work only for news. (evidence: promos 1.09; single image 0.21 n=26; 'AI ranks the 5 best' listicles 0-4 comments)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Comments come from opinions and science, not clips: one defended position post a week on a named source is the comment lane. (evidence: the only two 6,000+ comment posts were a study and a platform policy; 'has X sold out?' 564)

[DEFAULT][imagery] Footage gates run in code before any vision call: 720p floor, 1080 export, bright face-on footage, crop plus scale <=1.5x, faces kept in the 3:4 crop, no stickers, watermarks, ads or AI labels. (evidence: QUAL-01; dt.json quality_gates)

[DEFAULT][process] The market's taste is not the page's taste: a peer's winning format enters only through a door the page's own history confirms. (evidence: EDM mainstage 1.05 market vs 0.33 on DT; nostalgia 1.17 vs 0.70)

[DEFAULT][strategy] Entry points: a record's anniversary, a sample's origin, a celebrity crossover from the source channel, a place as the headline, an unexpected person hearing a track, a night from several angles, a scene rule change, a platform policy, a chart re-entry, a festival closing track. (evidence: dt.json formats table)
[DEFAULT][process] Compliance: DMCA pulls honoured, 'via @' credit for UGC, no ranking gimmicks, human posts only (draft-only, a person publishes from the calendar). (evidence: dt.json hard_rules)
[TRY][strategy] A scene rule-change explainer as a 2-slide card with the catch on slide 2. (evidence: X-15; Nath law explainers 31.5x)

[TRY][language] A scene-culture question as the last caption sentence on anniversary posts, and a finite tally question with a follow-up count; both need the owner's sign-off because they conflict with the no-ask rule. (evidence: X12/X-16; intimates comment prompt 11+/1-)
